What is Pheelm?

A home for films directed or co-directed by Black filmmakers, from any country or era: features, shorts, documentaries and animation. It’s free, and the catalog keeps growing.

About Pheelm https://www.pheelm.com/about

How do I find something to watch?

Open Films and filter by type, decade, country, language or genre, or search by title. Each film page has the synopsis, credits, a trailer when there is one, and where to watch it in your region.

Browse films https://www.pheelm.com/films

How do I save films?

Press Watchlist on any film to save it; everything you save is under Watchlist in the menu. Seen it already? Mark it Watched from the ⋯ menu on the film page.

Open your Watchlist https://www.pheelm.com/me

What are watchlists?

Themed lists of films, made by Pheelm and by members. To start one, press Watchlist on a film, type a name under New watchlist and select Create. Keep it private, share it, or invite others to curate it with you.

Browse watchlists https://www.pheelm.com/watchlists

Can I follow directors?

Yes. Open a director’s page and select Follow. When a new film of theirs is added, you’ll hear about it.

Find directors https://www.pheelm.com/directors

How do I set up my profile?

In Settings → Profile, choose a display name, handle, country and photo. Settings → Privacy lets you hide what you’ve watched or make your profile private.

Open Settings https://www.pheelm.com/account#profile

Which emails will I get?

Account and security emails when they’re needed. Everything else is your choice in Settings → Notifications, including the Digest of new films, sent daily or on Fridays at 4 pm Eastern.

Email settings https://www.pheelm.com/account#notifications

A film is missing or wrong. What do I do?

Pheelm is curated and still growing. Suggest a film that belongs here, or send a correction from any film page.

Suggest a film https://www.pheelm.com/submit

[[NOTE]]

You’re getting this because of your Pheelm account or a request you made to Pheelm.

Help https://www.pheelm.com/help · hey@pheelm.com · Privacy https://www.pheelm.com/privacy · Terms https://www.pheelm.com/terms

© [[YEAR]] Pheelm

fields.TITLE: Confirm your email
fields.PREHEADER: One quick step to finish creating your Pheelm account.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t create an account? You can ignore this email. Nothing happens unless the address is confirmed.
fields.L1: Use the button or the code
fields.T1: Select the button, or type the six-digit code on the sign-in page. Either one works.
fields.T2: The link and code work once and stop working after a short time. If they expire, ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
fields.T3: Pheelm will never ask you for it by email, message or phone.

fields.TITLE: Sign in to Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: Your one-time sign-in link and code.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t ask to sign in? Ignore this email and your account stays exactly as it is. If these keep arriving, write to hey@pheelm.com.
fields.L1: Open it where you want to sign in
fields.T1: Select the button on the device you’re signing in on, or type the code on the sign-in page.
fields.T2: Once you’re signed in, this link and code stop working. They also expire after a short time.
fields.T3: Don’t forward this email or share the code. Pheelm will never ask for it.

fields.TITLE: Reset your password
fields.PREHEADER: Choose a new password for your Pheelm account.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t ask for a reset? Ignore this email and your password stays the same.
fields.T1: Pick a password you don’t use anywhere else, at least 8 characters long.
fields.T2: The link and code work once and stop working after a short time. You can ask for another from the sign-in page.
fields.T3: Until you use this link, your current password keeps working.

fields.TITLE: Confirm your new email
fields.PREHEADER: Confirm the new email address for your Pheelm account.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t ask for this? Don’t select the button, and write to hey@pheelm.com so we can help you secure your account.
fields.T1: Once confirmed, you’ll sign in with this address and Pheelm will email you here.
fields.T2: Your watchlists, followed directors, comments and settings are not affected.
fields.T3: For your security, the old and the new address each get a notice when the change is complete.

fields.TITLE: Your sign-in email changed
fields.PREHEADER: The email address on your Pheelm account was changed.
fields.NOTE: Pheelm never asks for your password or sign-in code. We only email you about changes like this one.
fields.T1: The email address used to sign in to your account was updated. The old and the new address both receive this notice.
fields.T2: Nothing more to do. Use the new address to sign in from now on.
fields.T3: Write to hey@pheelm.com right away with “Account security” in the subject, and we’ll help you recover your account.

fields.TITLE: Welcome to Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: Your account is ready. Here’s a quick guide to Pheelm.
fields.NOTE: Still have a question? The Help page answers the most common ones, or just reply to this email.

account-deleted.subject: Your Pheelm account has been deleted

fields.TITLE: Your account has been deleted
fields.PREHEADER: Your Pheelm account is gone. Here’s what that means.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t delete your account? Write to hey@pheelm.com straight away so we can look into it.
fields.T1: Your profile, watchlists, follows, comments, notifications and profile photo were deleted along with your account.
fields.T2: You won’t receive further account emails. This is the last one unless you contact us.
fields.T3: You’re welcome to create a new account any time. Deleted content can’t be restored.

submission-received.subject: Your film submission is with Pheelm

fields.TITLE: We’ve received your film
fields.PREHEADER: Your film submission is in. It’s waiting for review.
fields.NOTE: Spotted a mistake in what you sent? Reply to this email and tell us what to fix.
fields.T1: We check each film’s details before adding it. You’ll get an email when the status changes.
fields.T2: Your film doesn’t appear on Pheelm until it has been reviewed and approved.
fields.T3: The reference above identifies this submission if you ever need to write to us.

submission-update.subject: An update on your Pheelm submission

fields.TITLE: An update on your submission
fields.PREHEADER: The review of your film submission has changed.
fields.NOTE: Thank you for helping improve the catalog.
fields.T1: Open your account and go to Submissions to see the current status and any notes from the team.
fields.T2: An approved submission has been accepted; it may take a little while to appear in the catalog.
fields.T3: You can send a corrected version, or write to hey@pheelm.com and we’ll explain.

fields.TITLE: We’ve got your message
fields.PREHEADER: We’ve got your message. Keep this email for your reference.
fields.NOTE: We can’t promise a specific response time. For quick answers, the Help page covers the most common questions.
fields.T1: Someone at Pheelm reads each message and replies when a reply is needed.
fields.T2: Replies come from Pheelm to this address, and you can reply to them directly.
fields.T3: Quote the reference above if you write to us again about this.

support-response.subject: A reply to your Pheelm message

fields.TITLE: A reply from Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: Pheelm has replied to your message.
fields.NOTE: This message was sent because you wrote to Pheelm. If that wasn’t you, you can ignore it.
fields.T1: Just answer this email to continue the conversation. It goes straight to the team.
fields.T2: Keep the reference at the end of the message in case you need to mention it later.
fields.T3: For a different question, use the contact page so it reaches the right person.

collection-invitation.subject: You’re invited to curate a Pheelm watchlist

fields.TITLE: You’re invited to curate a watchlist
fields.PREHEADER: You’ve been asked to help curate a watchlist.
fields.NOTE: You’re getting this because collaboration emails are on. You can switch them off in your account settings.
fields.T1: Curators can add films to the watchlist alongside its owner.
fields.T2: Open your notifications to accept or decline. Nothing changes until you answer.
fields.T3: If you accept, you can leave the watchlist later from its page.

fields.TITLE: Watchlist collaboration update
fields.PREHEADER: Something changed on a watchlist you collaborate on.
fields.NOTE: You’re getting this because collaboration emails are on. You can switch them off in your account settings.
fields.T1: An invitation, request or membership on a watchlist was updated. The details are in your notifications.
fields.T2: Open your notifications, where you can respond to anything that needs an answer.
fields.T3: Owners decide who curates their watchlist, and members can leave whenever they like.

fields.TITLE: Confirm your subscription
fields.PREHEADER: One tap to confirm your Pheelm newsletter subscription.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t sign up? Ignore this email. You won’t be subscribed, and this link expires on its own.
fields.T1: You’re not subscribed until you confirm. If you don’t, we won’t email you.
fields.T2: Occasional notes on films, directors and watchlists chosen by Pheelm. Never your data, never spam.
fields.T3: Every newsletter includes a link to unsubscribe in one step.

fields.TITLE: Discoveries from Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: This week’s films, directors and watchlists from Pheelm.
fields.NOTE: You’re receiving this because you subscribed to the Pheelm newsletter.
fields.T1: New and noteworthy films added to the catalog.
fields.T2: Filmmakers worth knowing, with the films to start with.
fields.T3: Public watchlists from the community worth a look.

fields.TITLE: New activity on Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: There’s something new waiting for you on Pheelm.
fields.NOTE: You can turn these emails off at any time under Email notifications in your account settings.
fields.T1: A reply, a mention, a comment on your watchlist, or a new film from a director you follow.
fields.T2: For your privacy we don’t put names or comments in emails. Sign in to read them.
fields.T3: We send no more than five of these an hour, however busy it gets.

fields.TITLE: New on Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: Your Pheelm digest: what’s new in the catalog.
fields.NOTE: Change how often you get this, or turn it off, under Email notifications in your account settings.

fields.TITLE: Your report to Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: We’ve received your report.
fields.NOTE: You can read the community guidelines in the Terms any time.
fields.T1: A person on the team reviews each report against the community guidelines.
fields.T2: We may not be able to share the details of moderation decisions that involve other members.
fields.T3: If you remember anything else that helps, reply to this email.

fields.TITLE: An important update from Pheelm
fields.PREHEADER: A moderation decision affects your account or content.
fields.NOTE: We send this only when a moderator has taken a specific action. It’s not an automated warning.
fields.T1: The message above explains what was changed and why.
fields.L2: You can ask for a review
fields.T2: If you think we got it wrong, reply to this email and explain. A person will look again.
fields.T3: The rules we apply are in the Terms, which everyone on Pheelm follows.

service-notice.subject: An important update about your Pheelm account

fields.TITLE: An important update about your account
fields.PREHEADER: A change affects how you use Pheelm.
fields.NOTE: We only send service notices when something truly affects your account.
fields.T1: The message above explains what is changing and when it takes effect.
fields.T2: If anything is needed from you, it’s explained above. Otherwise, nothing.
fields.T3: Write to hey@pheelm.com and we’ll help.

data-export-ready.subject: Your Pheelm data export is ready

fields.TITLE: Your data export is ready
fields.PREHEADER: Your Pheelm data export is ready to download.
fields.NOTE: Didn’t ask for an export? Write to hey@pheelm.com straight away.
fields.T1: The download is private to your account, so you’ll need to be signed in.
fields.T2: Use the link soon; after it expires you can ask for a new export.
fields.T3: Your export contains personal information. Store it somewhere you trust.

fields.TITLE: Pheelm needs your review
fields.PREHEADER: Items are waiting for your review.
fields.NOTE: You’re getting this because you’re a Pheelm admin.
fields.T1: Films waiting to be approved or sent back.
fields.T2: Comments and watchlists flagged by members.
fields.T3: Messages from members that need a reply.
